styles.notes: Counting (judgment call, flagged for coordinator): the page enumerates the serial as one letter digit followed by six numerical digits, states month from the 1st character letter and year from the 2nd-3rd numerical digits, and styles its example as E04*2555, grouping E04 as the date code. Character counting therefore ships: year = 2nd & 3rd characters [1,3] = '04' -> 2004. LIVE ALTERNATIVE RECORDED, NOT HIDDEN: digit-only counting would read the 2nd & 3rd numerical digits as '42', which is ambiguous under the century rule (1942 below floor, 2042 future) and would not resolve; that reading is not encoded.
